question: Detail how Russian seaborne crude oil supplies have been re-routed to India, China, Turkey and gulf re-export hubs since the G7/EU price cap and the EU oil ban took effect. Cover: (a) which ports of loading (Primorsk, Ust-Luga, Novorossiysk, Kozmino, Murmansk STS) feed which buyer-side terminals (Sikka, Mundra, Paradip, Qingdao, Dongjiakou, Ceyhan, Fujairah) and intermediate transship / STS hubs — and how cargoes are co-mingled or rebadged en route; (b) what vessel classes and charter chains dominate (Aframax, Suezmax, VLCC), how the so-called "shadow fleet" is structured through UAE / Hong Kong / Turkish / Indian shell operators, and which ultimate beneficial owners sit behind the visible traders — name the individuals where known and flag where only hypotheses exist; (c) which maritime corridors and choke points are used (Baltic Exits and Danish Straits, Bosporus, Gibraltar, Suez, Bab-el-Mandeb, Cape of Good Hope, Malacca, Northern Sea Route) and how they substitute each other when war-risk, insurance or pricing shifts; (d) the regulatory and insurance regimes in play (G7 $60/bbl cap, EU 14th and 15th packages, OFAC SDN designations, UK OFSI, IMO flag-state and port-state controls, International Group of P&I Clubs exclusions, Lloyd's market circulars) — which actors, sites, vessel classes and corridors are subject to or exposed to each, and what mitigates what; (e) how Urals and ESPO blend price relative to Brent, Dubai and Platts benchmarks, with typical Incoterms (FOB loadport, CIF Asia, CFR India, DES in STS transfers) and who publishes the reference prints; (f) the main corporate structures and recent transactions — Rosneft, Lukoil, Gazprom Neft, Surgutneftegas, Tatneft, Sinopec/Unipec, PetroChina, Reliance Industries, Indian Oil, Nayara Energy, Vitol, Glencore, Trafigura, Gunvor and the newer Dubai-registered traders that appeared after 2022 — including JV holdings, stake acquisitions, divestitures, spinoffs, board-level overlaps, and known or reported UBO links. Name all sanctioned individuals and entities involved. Separate verified facts from hypotheses, and flag what still needs fresh verification via web_search.
